review: No scenario changes: card types, costs, timing and outcomes of 308.1-1 and 308.1-2 check out against the Forge scripts. Triage 308.1 record_kinds gained playability, since 308.1-1 shows casting timing through playability verdicts.

scenarios.title: A kindred card is cast with the timing of its other card type

setup.notes: Tarfire is a Kindred Instant -- Goblin. Aquitect's Will is a Kindred Sorcery -- Merfolk. A has priority.

decisions: A has priority. The engine evaluates whether A may cast Tarfire (paying {R} with Mountain, targeting B) and whether A may cast Aquitect's Will (paying {U} with Island, targeting Mountain).

variants.label: own_main1
variants.expected: Both Tarfire and Aquitect's Will are legal to cast (can_play true).

variants.label: opponents_turn
variants.delta: The active player is B (step main1; B has passed priority so A holds it) instead of A.
variants.expected: Tarfire is legal to cast (can_play true). Aquitect's Will is not legal (can_play false).

scenarios.title: A kindred card resolves as its other card type does

setup.notes: Cloak and Dagger is a Kindred Artifact -- Rogue Equipment. Tarfire is a Kindred Instant -- Goblin.

decisions: A casts Cloak and Dagger, tapping both Mountains.
Both players pass; the spell resolves.

variants.label: kindred_artifact
variants.expected: Cloak and Dagger resolves and enters the battlefield under A's control as an artifact.

variants.label: kindred_instant
variants.delta: A casts Tarfire targeting B, tapping one Mountain, instead of Cloak and Dagger.
variants.expected: Tarfire resolves and deals 2 damage to B (18). It does not enter the battlefield and is put into A's graveyard.
